LESSON: APPROXIMATIONS AND ERRORS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurements 3.5 Money (7 lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, the learner sh
Topic 3.6: Approximations and Errors
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Approximations and Errors, part of Measurements 3.5 Money (7 lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, the learner sh in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we estimate measurements of different quantities?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Carry out activities in purposive groups/pairs of measurements of different quantities such as length, area, volume, capacity and mass using arbitrary units. Learners with manipulative difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or assistive technology or be assisted by peers, learner support assistants or the teacher to carry out activities of measurements. Create a conducive environment with adequate space for learners with mobility difficulty.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Carry out activities in purposive groups/pairs of measurements of different quantities such as length, area, volume, capacity and mass using arbitrary units. Learners with manipulative difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or assistive technology or be assisted by peers, learner support assistants or the teacher to carry out activities of measurements. Create a conducive environment with adequate space for learners with mobility difficulty.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Approximations and Errors together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination - as the learner carries out measurements of different quantities and discuss error.

● Digital literacy - as the learner uses IT devices to compute errors.

Values:
● Integrity - as the learner measures different quantities and minimize errors.

● Responsibility - as learner takes care of tools for measuring different quantities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Safety - as the learner handles measuring tools with care.

Link to other subjects:

Integrated science - as the learner measures different quantities that may involve errors as they carry out experiments.
